description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), causes [Imperil Ice 20% (25s)] and [Imperil Dark 20% (25s)], grants [Awoken Laguna Mania], [Damage Cap +10000], [Switch Draw Mode (Ice, Dark)] and [Max Pain Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Laguna Mania
description.text: Dark and Ice abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dark and Ice abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Switch Draw Mode (Ice, Dark)
description.text: Grants [Attach Ice]/[Attach Dark] after using a Ice/Dark ability

description.name: Max Pain Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Max Pain after using two Dark or Ice abilities
